crossRefs.note: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.
Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.
For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.
My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.
How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.
My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary…
My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;

translations.web: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
translations.bsb: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.
translations.kjv: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
translations.asv: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the droppings of the honeycomb.
